caseStudies.title: Scaling AI-driven customer and sales agents
caseStudies.summary: A practical use case that moved from prototype to controlled rollout in a regulated environment.

details.challenge: Launch a customer-service chatbot and recommendation agent without overstepping compliance boundaries or harming trust.
details.approach: Used a structured discovery loop, prompt design, and a staged rollout plan to safely test in production while maintaining oversight.
details.result: The solution reduced friction, improved response quality, and created a scalable operating model for future AI-assisted support.

caseStudies.title: High-stakes omnichannel pivot and fraud mitigation
caseStudies.summary: A fast-moving change program that kept the customer journey compliant under pressure.

details.challenge: Re-architect the in-store contracting funnel under a hard regulatory deadline while protecting the business from incentive-based fraud.
details.approach: Built a greylisting system and redesigned the journey so compliance and customer experience could advance together.
details.result: The change protected 18 stores, preserved legal compliance, and improved attached margin without adding friction.

caseStudies.title: Building a cross-sell orchestration platform
caseStudies.summary: A product system that blended automation, human control, and measurable commercial impact.

details.challenge: Create a centralized way to connect recommendation logic, manual overrides, and commercial workflows across multiple stakeholders.
details.approach: Designed a platform that combined algorithmic enablement with human decision support so adoption could scale quickly.
details.result: More than 100 stakeholders used the platform and recommendation effectiveness increased as the solution matured.
